elements.name: Honesty
elements.about: Telling the truth kindly, and helping others hear it.

elements.name: Kindness
elements.about: Noticing how others feel and caring for them gently.

elements.name: Laughter
elements.about: Bringing joy that includes everypony, never at their expense.

elements.name: Generosity
elements.about: Giving time, effort and credit freely.

elements.name: Loyalty
elements.about: Standing by friends, especially when it is hard.

elements.name: Magic
elements.about: Bringing friends together so their strengths become one.

archetypes.name: Broken Trust
archetypes.about: Two friends have fallen out because one believes the other betrayed them.
archetypes.twist: The accused pony may have broken a promise for a good reason.

archetypes.name: Friendship Versus Responsibility
archetypes.about: Two ponies have conflicting obligations and neither can keep theirs without disappointing the other.
archetypes.twist: There may be no answer that satisfies everypony completely.

archetypes.name: Fear and Misunderstanding
archetypes.about: A pony is avoided because others think they are dangerous, strange or untrustworthy.
archetypes.twist: The feared pony might really be causing trouble, but unintentionally.

archetypes.name: Friendship Under Pressure
archetypes.about: A pony is overwhelmed by responsibility or perfectionism and pushes others away.
archetypes.twist: Simply doing their work for them can reinforce the problem.

archetypes.name: Magical Friendship Crisis
archetypes.about: A magical effect amplifies jealousy, dishonesty, anger or suspicion.
archetypes.twist: Removing the magic does not undo the hurtful things that were said.

archetypes.name: The Excluded Friend
archetypes.twist: The excluded pony may want a different kind of friendship, or more independence.

emergencies.title: The Broken Promise
emergencies.event: {B} promised to help {A} with the {town} market stall, and never came.
open: {B} PROMISED to help with my stall today!
Everypony saw me set it up alone. I thought {B} was my friend.
other: I know I let {A} down. I just... can't explain right now.
Please don't tell {A} you saw me. I need to sort this out first.
emergencies.twist: {B} missed the stall to help a lost foal find home, and was too embarrassed to say so.

choices.text: Encourage {B} to tell {A} the whole truth
choices.outcome: {B} explains everything. {A} is moved: 'You did the right thing, I just wish you'd told me.'

choices.text: Remind {A} of every time {B} showed up for them
choices.outcome: {A} softens and agrees to hear {B} out, though the full story waits for another day.

choices.text: Ask {A} to give {B} time before deciding
choices.outcome: {A} agrees to wait. The hurt eases, slowly.

resolve: Thank you for not letting us give up on each other.

emergencies.title: The Missing Gift
emergencies.event: {A}'s handmade gift for the {town} celebration has vanished, and {A} suspects {B}.
open: My gift is gone! I spent weeks on it.
{B} was the only one who knew where I hid it.
other: Missing? Oh no. Oh no no no.
I can't say anything yet, but please trust me.
emergencies.twist: {B} borrowed the gift to fix a crack {A} hadn't noticed, hoping to surprise {A}.

choices.text: Let {B} explain before anypony accuses
choices.outcome: {B} reveals the half-repaired gift. {A} laughs with relief, then apologises.

choices.text: Suggest they finish the gift together
choices.outcome: The gift is mended by four hooves, but the accusation still stings a little.

choices.text: Throw a party so both can cool off
choices.outcome: The party helps, though the misunderstanding needs a real talk later.

resolve: It's even more special now. Thank you.

emergencies.title: The Unwanted Hero
emergencies.event: {B} is being praised all over {town} for something {A} did.
open: Everypony is cheering for {B}. For MY idea!
I thought {B} was my friend. Some friend.
other: I didn't ask for any of this praise.
Every time I try to explain, the crowd just cheers louder.
emergencies.twist: {B} tried to correct everypony, but nopony listened.

choices.text: Gather the evidence and tell the town together
choices.outcome: {A} and {B} share the stage. {town} cheers for both of them.

choices.text: Stand beside {A} and demand the credit
choices.outcome: The truth comes out, but {B} feels blamed for something they tried to stop.

choices.text: Suggest they share the credit quietly
choices.outcome: They agree to share it, though {A} still wishes the town knew.

resolve: I should have known {B} wouldn't steal from me.

emergencies.title: The Loyalty Dilemma
emergencies.event: {A} and {B} both asked for urgent help at the same time.
open: Please, I need you right now. You're the only one who can help!
{B} can wait, can't they?
other: I really need you too. I'm sorry to ask.
If you can't come, I understand. I think.
emergencies.twist: There isn't time to help both alone. Somepony will be disappointed.

choices.text: Bring friends together so both get help
choices.outcome: With everypony pitching in, both jobs are finished. Friendship really is magic.

choices.text: Keep your first promise and apologise to the other
choices.outcome: {A} is grateful. {B} is disappointed, but respects that you kept your word.

choices.text: Give up your own plans to try to cover both
choices.outcome: You manage both, exhausted. They're grateful, but worried about you.

resolve: We should have just asked each other for help.

emergencies.title: The Forgotten Birthday
emergencies.event: {A} missed {B}'s birthday party in {town} because of work.
open: I missed {B}'s birthday. I had a shift I couldn't skip.
{B} won't even look at me.
other: Everypony came. Except {A}.
I guess work matters more than me.
emergencies.twist: {A} couldn't leave without letting the whole {town} bakery down. Nopony gets everything they want.

choices.text: Help {A} plan a heartfelt belated surprise
choices.outcome: {B} is overjoyed by the surprise, and understands about the shift.

choices.text: Help {A} explain why work came first
choices.outcome: {B} understands, though the missed party still hurts a little.

choices.text: Throw an un-birthday party for everypony
choices.outcome: Everypony has fun. {B} forgives, but wishes it had been just the two of them.

emergencies.title: Two Friends, One Dream
emergencies.event: {A} and {B} both applied for the same apprenticeship in {town}.
open: Only one of us can get the apprenticeship.
I can't stop thinking {B} wants me to fail.
other: I want it so much. But I don't want to lose {A}.
We haven't spoken in days.
emergencies.twist: Only one can win, and whoever doesn't will need their friend most.

choices.text: Help them promise to cheer for whoever wins
choices.outcome: They shake hooves. Whoever wins, the other will be first in line to celebrate.

choices.text: Suggest the winner shares what they learn
choices.outcome: A kind plan, though the rivalry still simmers a little.

choices.text: Help them talk openly about their fears
choices.outcome: Talking helps. They're nervous, but no longer suspicious.

emergencies.title: A Rumour in Ponyville
emergencies.event: Gossip says {B} is jinxing the gardens of {town}, and {A} is afraid of them.
open: Every garden near {B}'s house is wilting!
Everypony says {B} is cursed. I'm scared to go near them.
other: Ponies cross the road when they see me now.
I don't know what I did wrong.
emergencies.twist: {B}'s new compost really is wilting the plants, completely by accident.

choices.text: Help {B} fix the compost, then introduce them to {A}
choices.outcome: The gardens recover, and {A} brings {B} the first bloom as a peace offering.

choices.text: Trace the rumour and share the facts
choices.outcome: The rumour stops, though {B} still feels lonely.

choices.text: Set up a garden party to break the ice
choices.outcome: The party is fun, but the plants keep wilting until the compost is fixed.

resolve: {B} isn't scary at all. I feel silly.

emergencies.title: A Friend in the Everfree
emergencies.event: After an argument, {B} ran off into the wilds near {town}. {A} is frantic.
open: We argued and {B} ran off toward the woods!
What if something happens? It's all my fault.
other: I'm alright. I just... didn't want to go back.
{A} said I always ruin everything.
emergencies.twist: {B} is safe, but afraid {A} doesn't want them back.

choices.text: Bring {A} along so {B} hears it from them
choices.outcome: {A} hugs {B} tight: 'I didn't mean it. Please come home.'

choices.text: Bring {B}'s favourite snack and just listen
choices.outcome: {B} feels heard and comes home, still nervous about facing {A}.

choices.text: Tell {B} exactly what {A} said
choices.outcome: {B} comes home, but the hurt words linger between them.

resolve: I'll never let an argument go that far again.

emergencies.title: Too Much on Their Plate
emergencies.event: {A} is running every event in {town} alone, and snapping at {B}.
open: I'm FINE. Everything has to be perfect and only I can do it.
If {B} wants to help, they can stay out of my way!
other: {A} hasn't slept in days. I only offered to help.
Now they won't even talk to me.
emergencies.twist: Doing all the work for {A} would only prove they can't rely on anypony.

choices.text: Gently point out the signs and offer to share the load
choices.outcome: {A} breaks down, then laughs. 'Maybe I can't do everything.' {B} takes half the list.

choices.text: Organise friends to each take one small task
choices.outcome: The events run smoothly, though {A} feels a little managed.

choices.text: Quietly do all of {A}'s chores yourself
choices.outcome: The work gets done, but {A} is back to doing everything alone the next week.

resolve: Asking for help is a strength. I'll remember that.

emergencies.title: The Discord Charm
emergencies.event: A mischievous trinket in {town} is making {A} and {B} suspicious of each other.
open: {B} is plotting something. I can FEEL it.
Ever since I found this charm, I know exactly who to blame.
other: {A} accused me of awful things today.
I said some awful things back. I don't know why.
emergencies.twist: Breaking the charm stops the suspicion, but not the unkind words already said.

choices.text: Break the charm, then help them apologise for what was said
choices.outcome: The charm shatters. {A} and {B} apologise, and mean it.

choices.text: Break the charm and call it solved
choices.outcome: The magic is gone, but the hurtful words still hang in the air.

choices.text: Comfort each pony separately first
choices.outcome: They feel cared for, but stay wary until the charm is dealt with.

resolve: That charm said the things we were too scared to. We'll talk properly now.

emergencies.title: A Pony Out of Place
emergencies.event: {B} just moved to {town}, and {A} thinks they're unfriendly.
open: I invited {B} to the big welcome party and they didn't come!
Maybe they just don't like us.
other: Big parties make my head spin.
I'd love a friend, just... a quieter kind of fun.
emergencies.twist: {B} wants friendship, just not the noisy kind everypony assumed.

choices.text: Arrange a small, quiet meet-up
choices.outcome: {A} and {B} spend the afternoon playing board games. A new friendship begins.

choices.text: Bring {B} a welcome basket from everypony
choices.outcome: {B} is touched, though still unsure where they fit in.

choices.text: Throw an even bigger welcome party
choices.outcome: {B} tries their best, but slips away early again.

resolve: Friendship comes in all sizes, doesn't it?

emergencies.title: The Great Prank Disaster
emergencies.event: {A}'s prank went too far and ruined {B}'s display in {town}.
open: It was just a joke! Why is {B} so upset?
Now nopony's laughing, and {B} won't speak to me.
other: Everypony laughed. At me.
I worked so hard on that display.
emergencies.twist: {A} thought {B} was in on the joke; {B} felt left out of the fun.

choices.text: Help {A} plan a joke {B} can be part of
choices.outcome: {B} gets to be the prankster this time, and both end up laughing together.

choices.text: Help repair the display together
choices.outcome: The display is fixed, and {B} feels better, if still a little wary of jokes.

choices.text: Have {A} apologise plainly
choices.outcome: The apology lands, though the fun between them takes time to return.

resolve: The best jokes are the ones everypony laughs at.
